freeze_rule: Execute only after the protocol freeze manifest exists. Retrieve without benchmark-match filtering. Union and deduplicate returned identifiers before screening.

github_api.note: Store total_count and the first 30 API-returned items for every query. The cap bounds screening; no relevance reordering is permitted.

snowballing_rule: For every included candidate, retrieve directly linked duplicate, patch, regression-test, upstream/downstream and backport records. Label these discovery_path=snowball; they do not become independent counts unless lineage evidence establishes an independent defect.
hard_exclusion: All development-seed identifiers and source URLs, plus exact clones, duplicates, backports, linked mass-fix descendants, and direct issue clones of those records.
